open_world.raw_value: requires the Company or any Company Subsidiary to make any investment (in each case, in the form of a loan, capital contribution or similar transaction) in any non-wholly owned Company Subsidiary or other Person in excess of $200,000

attributes.why_unmapped: No bucket covers equity/capital-contribution investment commitments in non-wholly-owned subsidiaries or third parties; this is an outbound investment, not CAPEX_COMMITMENTS (physical asset spend) or INDEBTEDNESS (borrowing), and Joint Venture Agreements are expressly carved out of this clause.

open_world.raw_value: evidences a loan (whether secured or unsecured) made to any other Person (excluding ordinary course extensions of trade credit or rent relief), with a principal amount, individually or in the aggregate, greater than $200,000

attributes.why_unmapped: No bucket covers loans made by the Company as lender to third parties; INDEBTEDNESS in this vocabulary covers borrowings by the Company (see the separate clause on Indebtedness for borrowed money), and EMPLOYEE_LOANS is limited to employee loans/advances.

open_world.raw_value: relates to a forward equity sale transaction

attributes.why_unmapped: No bucket covers forward equity sale transactions; this is listed as a distinct category from the hedging/derivative clause and is not an M&A agreement of the Company itself.
